designs.evidence: published inputs from several sources, combined (illustrative)

designs.name: Replica groups (torchft-style)
designs.C_note: torchft: no checkpoint needed while one replica group is healthy

notes.detect: torchft demo: Gloo timeout set to 5 s on all cross-group operations (PyTorch blog, Jun 2025)
notes.start: illustrative: restart of one replica group; not published
notes.load: illustrative: weights and optimiser state copied from a healthy peer; not published

designs.evidence: mechanism published (torchft, demonstrated on 300 L40S); times illustrative
designs.what: Only the failed replica group restarts; the other groups keep training with a smaller batch and the step in flight is discarded.
designs.keep_note: illustrative: 16 replica groups, 15 keep training during the recovery; the failure costs the step in flight (10 s step, illustrative)
